# Talker alias (DMRA) and GPS (DMRG) packets for radio 3109999, as MMDVMHost 9384d683 writes them to DMRGateway (mmdvmhost)
# and as DMRGateway d751e20e forwards them to a master (dmrgateway). DMRGateway inserts its repeater ID, 00beef01 here, and
# then writes the length of the MMDVMHost packet, so the 15-octet DMRA keeps 3 of the 7 data octets and the 14-octet DMRG
# keeps 3 of the 7 position octets (DMRGateway DMRNetwork.cpp:314-352). The writers of both programs were compiled from
# source and run on 2026-10-22 in the e2e interop lane:
# /home/reddragon/.claude/jobs/a75b2a9e/tmp/e2e/iapps/gwgps/net_vectors.txt (NOTES.md in that directory has the method).
# 7bit_N0CALL is the 7-bit alias "N0CALL" (header only), 7bit_call_name the 7-bit alias "N1CALL Alice" (header and block 1),
# utf16_N0CALL the UTF-16 alias "N0CALL" (header and block 1), and dallas a GPS position.
# Columns: the writer, the vector, the packet.
mmdvmhost 7bit_N0CALL 444d52412f746f000d398438332600
dmrgateway 7bit_N0CALL 444d524100beef012f746f000d3984
mmdvmhost 7bit_call_name 444d52412f746f0019398c38332620
mmdvmhost 7bit_call_name 444d52412f746f0183b34e3ca00000
dmrgateway 7bit_call_name 444d524100beef012f746f0019398c
dmrgateway 7bit_call_name 444d524100beef012f746f0183b34e
mmdvmhost utf16_N0CALL 444d52412f746f00cc004e00300043
mmdvmhost utf16_N0CALL 444d52412f746f010041004c004c00
dmrgateway utf16_N0CALL 444d524100beef012f746f00cc004e
dmrgateway utf16_N0CALL 444d524100beef012f746f01004100
mmdvmhost dallas 444d52472f746f0376554a2e9da2
dmrgateway dallas 444d524700beef012f746f037655
